runtime:

  working_dir: /tmp
  env:
    HTTPS_PROXY: ${CORP_PROXY}

    oc_00000000000000000000000000000001: [on_00000000000000000000000000000002]

aliases:
  on_00000000000000000000000000000002: 另一位用户
messaging:
  cot_tool_details: true
